title: One Unlimited Membership per Customer
content:
**Customer care guidance note — Marlowe & Finch Unlimited holdings**

A customer holds at most 1 Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership that is not expired. Moving between plans is a plan change, never a second membership. Expired memberships do not count toward the limit, and a customer may rejoin after the plan's rejoining wait, which is 0 calendar days on every plan. The cap is the plan's limit of Unlimited memberships open at once per customer.

In terms of the membership status shown on the record: a membership in status trial, active, past due or cancellation pending counts toward the limit of 1; a membership in status expired does not.

| Customer's existing Marlowe & Finch Unlimited memberships | A further membership may be opened |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| Only expired memberships, the rejoining wait having passed | Yes |
| One membership in status trial, active, past due or cancellation pending | No — the limit of 1 is reached; a different plan is reached by a plan change |

Hypothetical cases:

- A customer whose Unlimited Standard Monthly membership expired, and who wishes to join Unlimited Express Annual, joins it as a new membership once the rejoining wait has passed; the expired membership does not count.
- A customer holding an active Unlimited Standard Annual membership who wishes to hold Unlimited Next-Day Annual instead moves to it by a plan change on the same membership; a second membership is not opened.
- A customer whose membership is in status cancellation pending still holds a membership that is not expired, so the limit of 1 is reached until that membership expires.
